name: AB-1005
sort_evidence: AB-1005 is AskBio's AAV2-GDNF gene therapy for Parkinson's disease in the Phase 2 REGENERATE-PD programme, with Japanese Phase 2 NCT07566429 not yet recruiting (https://www.bayer.com/media/en-us/first-participants-randomized-in-askbio-phase-ii-gene-therapy-trial-for-parkinsons-disease/).

trials.title: A Study of AB-1005 Gene Therapy in Japanese Adults With Moderate Parkinson's Disease (J-REGENERATE-PD)
